_note: RPS 2000/2011 Moroccan parasismic overlay (spec §7.10 [REF-MATH-710]). PROVISIONAL — gate G-RPS (§14.5/§14.6): every cell marked ⚠ in §7.10b awaits ratification by the nominated structural engineer before M4b acceptance. The TABLE SHAPE, the override mechanism, and the dispatch are FINAL; only the values change once signed. The engine reads this the same way regardless.

criticalZone._note: l_c plastic-hinge length at member ends (§7.10a). ⚠ VERIFY against RPS 2011 text. Column: max(h_section_max, H_clear/6, 450 mm); Beam: 2·h from each support face.

critSpacing._note: max tie spacing in a critical zone (mm), per ND class (§7.10b). s_crit = min(phiLMultiple·φ_ℓ, bMinFraction·b_min, cap). ⚠ VERIFY.

minTieDiameter_mm._note: min transverse ø inside a critical zone (§7.10b). ⚠ VERIFY.

confinement._note: required confinement add-on supplement ids per ND class (§7.10b/c). ⚠ VERIFY which add-ons. ND3 = every long. bar engaged.

engagement._note: lateral engagement of longitudinal bars by tie corners / cross-ties (§7.10b, predicate crosstie_engagement). ⚠ VERIFY.

longRatioUplift._note: uplift factor applied to the base pack's column AsMin per ND class (§7.10b). ⚠ VERIFY.

lapTier._note: laps/splices forbidden in critical zones (§7.10c): ND2/3 FAIL, ND1 WARN.

zones._note: zone → a_g (m/s²) map (§7.10 zone note). ⚠ VERIFY (RPS 2000 vs 2011 zonation). Engine treats zone as an opaque key.
